changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Model_Fields] AS select O.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID as ID, T.ObjectID as TaxonomyTypeID, D.DisplayValue, null as TextPath, F.FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from Asset O inner join AssetType T on T.ID = O.AssetTypeID and T.Class = 2 and O.State = 1 inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = O.ID inner join Field F on F.AssetID = O.ID inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Model_Fields] AS select O.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID as ID, T.ObjectID as TaxonomyTypeID, D.DisplayValue, null as TextPath, F.FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from Asset O inner join AssetType T on T.ID = O.AssetTypeID and T.Class = 2 and O.State = 1 inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = O.ID inner join Field F on F.ObjectType = O.Object and F.ObjectID = O.ObjectID inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID
